definitions.explanation: Fine dry particles of matter, especially those found on surfaces or in the air.

examples.japanese: {本棚|ほんだな}に{埃|ほこり}がたまっている。
examples.english: Dust has accumulated on the bookshelf.

examples.japanese: {埃|ほこり}を{払|はら}ってから{使|つか}ってください。
examples.english: Please dust it off before using.
examples.notes: 埃を払う = to dust off

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}は{埃|ほこり}っぽい。

notes:
USAGE: {埃|ほこり} specifically refers to dust particles, not general dirt.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{埃|ほこり}がたまる (dust accumulates)
・{埃|ほこり}を{払|はら}う (to dust off)
・{埃|ほこり}を{被|かぶ}る (to be covered in dust)
・{埃|ほこり}っぽい (dusty)
・{埃|ほこり}だらけ (covered in dust)

HOMOPHONE: {誇|ほこ}り (pride) - same pronunciation but different meaning and kanji

RELATED:
・{塵|ちり} (fine dust, litter)
・{汚|よご}れ (dirt, stain)
